registered_before_results: 2026-11-08; committed before any opening_seed result was computed
diagnosis: Reproduced wave_capture (byte-identical). Of 365 hindsight reference legs, 106 start in the first eight 5m bars (first 40m) where the control is blind (six-bar in-session ATR warmup; extreme initialised at index6; first signal index7). Only 5/106 are early(<=25% consumed) matches versus 35/183 for legs starting at index>=18.
single_change: Seed the ATR6 window at session open with the true ranges of the last six complete 5m bars of the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING XNYS session (known before the open). For index i<6 the window is the last (6-i) prior-session true ranges plus in-session true ranges 0..i-1; in-session bar0 true range stays high-low (no overnight gap). Extreme initialises at index0 close; first possible signal at index1 close (open+10m). For i>=6 the threshold is identical to control. Everything else unchanged: 5-point floor, frozen thresholds at extreme update, 30m cooldown, closed-bar decisions, execution engine, reference legs, matching.
fallback: If the immediately preceding XNYS session is not an accepted complete session in the same input, the day uses the unchanged control detector; the count of such days is reported.
data: Same previously consumed 116 sessions (raw sha256 7d263ec61a6e582b17a69097d6d14643b94e5645f3c8dd02590a520b07cd8a1b), split 2026-09-14 (resolution confounded with time). This is NOT an independent holdout. Separate descriptive forward check: complete sessions after 2026-11-04 present in research/frozen_forward_20261103/v2 SPX_raw.json (5m, provider-declared delayed=900s), never used to decide.
primary_metric: Early reference matches (same-side new signal before 25% of leg consumed), one-to-one, unchanged matching code and 365 unchanged legs.
decision_rule: QUALIFIES_FOR_UNUSED_PROSPECTIVE_SHADOW_ONLY iff ALL: (a) seeded early matches > control in older AND recent blocks; (b) paired session bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 801) of per-session (seeded - control) early matches over all sessions has 95% lower bound > 0; (c) guardrail per block: matched_before75pct not lower than control; (d) guardrail per block: unmatched signals per session increase <= 0.5. Otherwise REJECT_CHANGE_KEEP_CONTROL. Either way status stays NOT_READY, alerts OFF.
reported_not_decisive: median lag and consumed points of matched legs
early recall for legs starting in first 40m
same-side signal within 15m BEFORE leg start (descriptive pre-onset lead)
net index points at cost 0.5/1/2 and latency 0/15/60 via unchanged score()
no_tuning: No parameter search. Seed length six equals the existing ATR6. No change after results; failures are retained.
preservation: No modification to wave_capture, objective_review engine, frozen candidate, alert routes, schedules, main, deployments or orders. No option prices, no LIVE_VERIFIED claim.
